risk_if_not_implemented: Without Fire Detection Devices, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Injury / Loss of Life (R-SF-1), Physical / Environmental Damage (R-SF-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-3, MT-6, MT-7, MT-9, MT-10, MT-21, MT-27.

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Fire Detection Devices (PES-27) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Fire Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Facility security mechanisms exist to utilize and maintain fire suppression and detection devices/systems for the system that are supported by an independent energy source.
compensating_control_2.justification: Fire Protection (PES-26) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Fire Detection Devices (PES-27) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
